title: Resolve thirteen catalogue and registry identity decisions deferred from Step 7d
body:
Observed during the full current-owner Step 7d review for #901 at main `467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1`. These are proposed corrections or explicit deferrals before source writes; structural validation is not scientific approval. Exact owner preimages, primary-source capture hashes and full rubrics are prepared under `reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/` for the implementation PR.

These **13 owners are dropped in full** from Step 7d. Each needs a source-material, registry-scope or ontology decision before even a relation-only update is safe. Source records, chemistry, memberships and mapping holds remain unchanged.

| Owner | Observed conflict and primary evidence | Options to resolve | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`A-Ketoglutaric_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/A-Ketoglutaric_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | Sigma K3752 uses variable-water hydrate wording and CAS 305-72-6, also used for the dry disodium compound. [supplier-K3752](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sial/k3752); [sigma-sid-K3752](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sid/329817140/JSON); [pubchem-cas-305-72-6](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/305-72-6/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON) | Decide whether the source CAS is a defensible identity for the complete commercial hydrate, or whether a distinct local supplied-form owner is required. | Obtain the source specification and record the CAS-versus-supplied-form ruling; retain this owner unchanged meanwhile. |
| [`Adenine_Hydrochloride_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Adenine_Hydrochloride_Hydrate.yaml) | A8751 specifies C5H5N5·HCl·xH2O, while CAS 2922-28-3/PubChem 76219 denotes water-free hydrochloride. [supplier-A8751](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/a8751); [sigma-deposit-A8751](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sourceid/Sigma-Aldrich/A8751_SIGMA/JSON); [pubchem-cas-2922-28-3](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/2922-28-3/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON) | Establish whether the CAS concept includes the commercial hydrate, or retain a separately identified hydrate material. | Do not mint or promote by inference; obtain the original specification and make the owner-boundary decision. |
| [`Bathophenanthrolinedisulfonic_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Bathophenanthrolinedisulfonic_Acid_Disodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | Historical catalogue 146617 is a trihydrate, but candidate CHEBI:234116 places sulfonates at phenanthroline 3,8, whereas current CHEBI:78157 represents phenyl 4′,4″ positions. [supplier-146617](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/aldrich/146617); [chebi-78157](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/78157/); [chebi-232316](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/232316/); [CHEBI:234116 candidate](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/234116/) | Verify the actual supplied positional isomer, then select its form-specific term or distinct registry identity; alternatively document that the catalogue/label association is wrong. | Resolve positional structure from the original specification. Label and formula agreement alone cannot choose the candidate. |
| [`Ceftazidime_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Ceftazidime_Hydrate.yaml) | Historical C3809 is a stabilized ceftazidime hydrate preparation with sodium carbonate. [sigma-deposit-C3809](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sourceid/Sigma-Aldrich/C3809_SIGMA/JSON); [pubchem-cas-120618-65-7](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/120618-65-7/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON); [chebi-3508](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/3508/) | Decide whether this owner denotes the active hydrate or the complete stabilized product; the latter needs preparation/component representation based on source evidence. | Obtain the historical product composition and retain the whole owner unchanged; do not guess hydration or remove carbonate from the product concept. |
| [`CrKSO42_X_12_H2O`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/CrKSO42_X_12_H2O.yaml) | CAS 7788-99-0 supports potassium chromium sulfate dodecahydrate. Current CHEBI:53471 chromium(III) sulfate omits potassium and has different sulfate stoichiometry. [pubchem-cas-7788-99-0](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/7788-99-0/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON); [chebi-53471](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/53471/) | Identify an exact whole double-salt term or justify the appropriate whole-material parent relationship; a chromium sulfate-only hydrate relation is insufficient. | Keep the existing local owner and hold pending an explicit double-salt grounding decision; do not invent component assertions. |
| [`DL-Isocitric_Acid_Trisodium_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/DL-Isocitric_Acid_Trisodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | Sigma I1252 is a variable-water DL-isocitrate trisodium hydrate. CHEBI:172950 and CAS 1637-73-6 describe a water-free trisodium representation despite the acid-like label. [web:I1252](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/i1252); [v1:29-pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/1637-73-6/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,IUPACName/JSON); [v1:29-chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/172950/) | Determine whether the registry/ontology concept genuinely includes the supplied hydrate or only its dry parent. | Preserve the local hydrate owner; do not promote merely because the supplier repeats the same CAS. |
| [`Fosmidomycin_Sodium_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Fosmidomycin_Sodium_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | Catalogue CAS 66508-37-0 comes with FW 183.1. NCIT:C223823 defines sodium fosmidomycin at 205.08; supplier F8682 instead uses variable sodium/water, CAS 66508-53-0 and free-acid-basis 183.10. [web:F8682](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/f8682); [v1:33-pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/66508-37-0/property/MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,IUPACName/JSON); [prior:ncit-C223823-fosmidomycin-sodium](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C223823?include=full) | Recover the actual supplier/material to distinguish a fixed monosodium compound from a variable sodium hydrate; correct a source transcription only with evidence. | Do not assign F8682 to a catalogue row with no supplier or promote to NCIt solely by CAS overlap. |
| [`Gold_Iii_Chloride_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Gold_Iii_Chloride_Hydrate.yaml) | Source CAS 27988-77-8 is associated with HAuCl4·aq by supplier 254169; current CHEBI:30076 is AuCl3. [web:gold254169](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/aldrich/254169); [v1:37-chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/30076/) | Resolve the source as chloroauric acid/tetrachloroaurate hydrate versus gold trichloride hydrate, then choose the whole-material identity and parent. | Keep the owner unchanged; do not substitute the tetrachloroaurate anion or infer a water count from a display structure. |
| [`Neomycin_Trisulfate_Salt_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Neomycin_Trisulfate_Salt_Hydrate.yaml) | Catalogue N1142 currently identifies neomycin 10 mg/mL in 0.9% NaCl, conflicting with the archived trisulfate hydrate name. [supplier-neomycin](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/n1142); [Neomycin_Trisulfate_Salt_Hydrate--pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/1405-10-3/JSON); [Neomycin_Trisulfate_Salt_Hydrate--chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/31635/) | Recover the historical N1142 specification and decide active substance versus complete saline formulation. | Retain the owner unchanged; do not equate a solution, sulfate mixture and hydrate powder. |
| [`Potassium_Tellurite_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Potassium_Tellurite_Hydrate.yaml) | Archive P0677/CAS 123333-66-4 says hydrate; current P0677 lot MKCQ8564 gives CAS 7790-58-1, K2O3Te and mass 253.79. [Potassium_Tellurite_Hydrate--pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/123333-66-4/JSON); [supplier-tellurite-coa](https://cloud-qa.sial.com/certificates/COFA/P0/P0677/P0677-BULK________MKCQ8564__.pdf); [Potassium_Tellurite_Hydrate--chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/75248/) | Establish whether the historical catalogue denoted a different product/form or contains an incorrect CAS/label. | Use original source material evidence; do not silently adopt the current dry-salt CAS. |
| [`Sodium_Hypophosphite_Monohydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Sodium_Hypophosphite_Monohydrate.yaml) | Primary S5012 certificate supports NaH2PO2·H2O and 105.99 g/mol, while current CHEBI:234148 and derived structures omit the two phosphorus-bound hydrogens. [sigma-hypophosphite-coa](https://www.sigmaaldrich.cn/certificates/Graphics/COfAInfo/fluka/pdf/PDF690391.pdf); [Sodium_Hypophosphite_Monohydrate--pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/10039-56-2/JSON); [Sodium_Hypophosphite_Monohydrate--chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/234148/) | Select a chemically defensible parent/exact term and resolve the ontology structure discrepancy; otherwise retain a registry identity with an explicitly justified broader parent. | Do not approve the present parent or import the erroneous PubChem hydrate formula. Request a source/ontology ruling before any predicate change. |
| [`Terpene_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Terpene_Hydrate.yaml) | Source CAS 2451-01-6 is associated with terpin hydrate; CHEBI:751529/NCIT:C219387 names and unstereospecified structures need reconciliation with GSRS S3V868548T cis-relative scope. [prior-primary-gsrs-terpin-hydrate-full](https://gsrs.ncats.nih.gov/api/v1/substances/S3V868548T?view=full); [Terpene_Hydrate--pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/2451-01-6/JSON); [prior-primary-ncit-C219387-terpin-hydrate](https://api-evsrest.nci.nih.gov/api/v1/concept/ncit/C219387?include=full) | Determine whether the exact concept denotes the supplied cis material, a broader stereochemical class, or a differently scoped substance. | Retain the current CAS owner and hold; do not select the exact ontology identity or rename the material until the cis scope is settled. |
| [`Vancomycin_Hydrochloride_Hydrate`](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/467aa319a06ef992035f509f66fe251082b44ae1/data/ingredients/mapped/Vancomycin_Hydrochloride_Hydrate.yaml) | Archive lists Sigma and MP:195545-250MG; inspected MP certificate is catalogue 195540, lot S4331, with dry hydrochloride formula and 1.3% water. [Vancomycin_Hydrochloride_Hydrate--pubchem-cas](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/123409-00-7/JSON); [supplier-vancomycin](https://www.mpbio.com/media/document/infor/S/4/3/3/1/S4331.pdf); [Vancomycin_Hydrochloride_Hydrate--chebi-parent](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/9932/) | Recover the exact historical SKU/specification and decide the commercial material/hydrate scope. | Do not silently correct the SKU, assign the inspected lot or import the implausible CAS-resolved PubChem structure. |

Scope and deduplication: the 13 unresolved raw formula-labelled hydrates are tracked on #459, not duplicated here. G6501 remains on #1118; the coupled sodium phosphate correction stays on #758/#740; the potassium trihydrate owner collision belongs with existing #656. Closed #326 recorded a limited inherited-formula repair with intentional exclusions; it does not settle the new source/SKU and ontology boundaries above. Closed #455 concerned a different `potassium tellurate` owner and Te(VI)/Te(IV) conflict, not this P0677 hydrate history. #718 and #901 remain the broader review backlogs.

Acceptance: settle each row explicitly from primary source and exact existing-owner context, document the chosen material boundary and rejected alternatives, then propose a separately reviewed guarded correction. Keep unresolved rows open. No guessed water count, invented catalogue assignment, role approval, automatic promotion or owner merge. This issue does not authorize any edit to these 13 owners in Step 7d.
